open: In the name of Allah. Assalamu alaikum, my dears. Come closer, tonight’s story is very beautiful.
s1a: Shh. Noah, Ilyas. Imagine mysterious guests knocking at a door. They look like ordinary men, but they are something completely different.
s1c: I’ll tell you in a moment. Get warm and cosy… Tonight I’ll tell you about the Prophet Lut, peace be upon him. Do you remember? Lut is the one who believed in Ibrahim and went with him to the blessed land: “And Lut believed him.”
s2a: Allah sent Lut to a town whose people did very bad things that Allah has forbidden: “You obstruct the road and commit in your meetings every evil.”
s2b: Lut said to them: “So fear Allah and obey me. And I do not ask you for it any payment.”
s2c: And did they listen to him?
s2d: No. Instead they said: “Expel the family of Lut from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure.”
s3a: One day, guests came to Ibrahim; “they said, ‘Peace.’ He said, ‘Peace,’ and did not delay in bringing them a roasted calf.”
s3b: “But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension.”
s3c: “They said, ‘Fear not,’” and they gave him the good news of a boy: “Then We gave her good tidings of Ishaq.”
s3d: Angels! That’s why they didn’t eat!
s3e: That’s right, my dear. Then they said: “We have been sent to the people of Lut.” Ibrahim said: “Indeed, within it is Lut.” They said: “We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife.”
s4a: Then the angels came to Lut: “he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, ‘This is a trying day.’”
s4b: “And his people came hastening to him.” Lut said to them: “So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?”
s4c: And what did the guests do?
s4d: The angels said: “O Lut, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back.”
s5a: So Lut and his family left at night, as they had been commanded, and no one looked back.
s5b: And when morning came, what Allah had announced happened: “We made the highest part of the city its lowest and rained upon them stones.” Lut’s wife stayed with them, because she did not believe.
s5d: Yes, my dear. Lut had warned them, but they did not want to listen. And Allah saved Lut and those who believed with him.
s6a: Allah says about Lut: “And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.” He spoke the truth, and he protected his guests, as a generous host does.
s7a: They’ve fallen asleep… Always listen to what is good, even if others laugh. Honour your guests. And choose good friends who bring you closer to Allah, for every person is responsible for their own deeds.
s7b: And next time, I’ll tell you about Ismail… and about a spring in the middle of the desert that still flows today. And you, watching us right now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don’t miss the next story.
close: And you, dear fathers and mothers: subscribe to our channel, and share these stories with the people you love, so that together we pass on the beautiful message of Islam to our children.
final: Good night, my dears. I entrust you to Allah, with whom nothing entrusted is ever lost.
